notes: Eight web searches ran, none refused; none returned any AI-related statement by Pulido. Coverage of his campaign (Texas Tribune, KSAT, BOLD PAC, GiveGreen) lists healthcare, cost of living, immigration, water and rural issues, not AI. bobbypulido.com is his music site and has no AI content; pulidoforcongress.com returned an empty page, so a campaign issues page was not checked. A Texas Tribune article on AI super PACs in Texas races (1 April 2026) does not mention him. He was not a member of Congress, so he could not have sponsored the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act. Ballotpedia reports he defeated incumbent Monica De La Cruz on 3 November 2026.
